spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (ऋ) तिकृ (तेकते)
To go or move.
r. 5th cl. (तिक्नोति)
1 To go.
2 To assail, to assault.
3 To seek to injure or kill: see तिग.

(ऋ) तीकृ r. 1st cl. (तिकते)
To go or move.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1

Bitter.
2

Fragrant.
m. (-क्तः)
1 A bitter taste, bitterness.
2 Fragrance, perfume.
3 A medicinal plant, (Echites antidysenterica.)
4 A tree, (Capparis trifoliata): see वरुण.
f. (-क्ता)
Katuki, a medicinal plant.
n. (-क्तं)
A medicinal plant, (Mollugo pentaphylla.)
E.
तिज to sharpen, (the appetite,) affix क्त.

m. (-कः)
1 A kind of gourd, (Trichosanthes diœca, Rox.)
2 A sort of gentian, (G. cherayta.)
3 A dark sort of the Khayar or Mimosa catechu.
E.
कन् added to तिक्त a bitter; alluding to the taste of these substances.

f. (-न्धा)
A plant, (Lycopodium imbricatum, Rox.)
E.
तिक्त fragrant, and गन्ध smell, fem. affix टाप्; also with कन् added, and the fem. form, तिक्तगन्धिका.

f. (-म्बी)
A bitter gourd.
E.
तिक्त, and तुम्बी a gourd.

f. (-ग्धा)
A medicinal kind of moon plant: see स्वर्णक्षीरी.
E.
तिक्त bitter, and दुग्ध milk.

m. (-त्रः)
A cucurbitaceous plant, (Momordica mixta.)
E.
तिक्त bitter, and पत्र a leaf.

f. (-र्व्वां)
1 A potherb, (Hilancha repens.)
2 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.)
3 Liquorice.
E.
तिक्त bitter, and पर्व्वन् a joint.

m. (-कः)
A kind of cucumber, (Trichosanthes dioeca.)
E.
तिक्त bitter, and भद्रक auspicious, useful in medicine.

f. (-का)
A medicinal plant: see कटुकी.
E.
तिक्त bitter, and रोहिणी the same plant, कन् added.

f. (-ल्ली)
A plant, (Aletris hyacinthoides.)
E.
तिक्त bitter, and वल्ली a stalk.

m. (-कः)
1 A plant, (Capparis trifoliata): see वरुण.
2 A kind of mimosa: see खदिर.
E.
तिक्त bitter, and शाक an esculent vegetable; also तिक्तशाकक.

m. (-रः)
A sort of mimosa, (M. catechu): see खदिर
E.
तिक्त bitter, and सार pith.

f. (-का)
A bitter gourd.
E.
तिक्त, and कन् aff.

mfn. (-क्ष्णः-क्ष्णा-क्ष्णं)
1 Hot, warm.
2 Hot, pungent.
3 Selfdevoted, self-abandoning, committing suicide, &c.
4 Zealous, active, warm.
5 Keen, intelligent.
6 Devout, ascetic, a devotee, a zealot.
7 Sharp, (as a sword.)
n. (-क्ष्णं)
1 Heat, warmth.
2

Poison.
3

Iron.
4

War, battle.
5 Plague, pestilence, epidemic destruction.
6 Death, dying.
7 Any weapon.
8 Haste, hurry.
9 Sea salt.
10 The scrotum or testicles.
11 Any metal.
12 Pungency, the heat of pepper, &c.
m. (-क्ष्णः)
Nitre.
f. (-क्ष्णा)
1 Orris root.
2 The cast skin of a snake.
E.
तिज to sharpen or be sharp, Uṇādi affix क्स्न.

m. (-कः)
1 The scrotum or the testicles.
2 White mustard.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-कः)
Thorn apple, (Datura metel.)
E.
तीक्ष्ण sharp, and कण्टक a thorn.

m. (-न्दः)
The onion.
E.
तीक्ष्ण pungent, and कन्द root.

mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
Active, zealous.
E.
तीक्ष्ण sharp, keen, and कर्म्मन् conduct.

m. (-न्धः)
1 Morunga hyperanthera.
2 The gum olibanum tree.
3 Small cardamoms.
4 A tree: see जियती.
f. (-न्धा)
Mustard seed.
2 Orris root.
3 Pandanus odoratissimus.
E.
तीक्ष्ण sharp, and गन्ध smell; also with कन् added तीक्ष्णगन्धक.

f. (-ला)
Long-pepper.
E.
तीक्ष्ण pungent, and तण्डल grain.

Resin.
2
The milky juice of the

Euphorbia.
3

Spirituous or vinous liquor.
E.
तीक्ष्ण hot, pungent, and तैल oil, unguent.

m. (-ष्ट्रः)
A tiger.
E.
तीक्ष्ण sharp, and दंष्ट्र a tooth.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Sharp-edged, sharp.
E.
तीक्ष्ण, and धारा edge.

m. (-त्रः)
Coriander.
E.
तीक्ष्ण pungent, and पत्र a leaf.

n. (-ष्पं)
Cloves.
E.
तीक्ष्ण pungent, and पुष्प flower.

m. (-लः)
Coriander.
E.
तीक्ष्ण pungent, and फल fruit, bearing pungent seeds.

m. (-सः)
Saltpetre.
E.
तीक्ष्ण sharp, and रस juice.

m. (-कः)
Barley.
E.
तीक्ष्ण sharp, and शूक awn.

m. (-ग्निः)
Heartburn, dyspepsia.
E.
तीक्ष्ण, and अग्नि digestion.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
Made of steel, sharp.
n. (-सं)
Steel.
E.
तीक्ष्ण, and अयस् iron, टच् added.
